prompt: Error boundary UX with httpResource .error()/.reload(), retry interceptor, ErrorHandler bypass understanding

assertions.name: httpresource-error-not-errorhandler
assertions.description: Code or comments explicitly state httpResource errors surface via .error() signal and do NOT reach ErrorHandler

assertions.name: httpresource-reload-pattern
assertions.description: Retry button calls .reload() on the httpResource to re-fetch

assertions.name: error-signal-display
assertions.description: Template displays httpResource error state via .error() signal, not via ErrorHandler/error boundary

assertions.name: retry-interceptor-exponential
assertions.description: Retry interceptor uses exponential backoff for 503 errors

assertions.name: http-context-token-opt-out
assertions.description: Uses HttpContextToken to let specific requests opt out of retry

assertions.name: errorhandler-for-component-errors
assertions.description: Custom ErrorHandler receives component/lifecycle errors (not httpResource errors)

assertions.name: test-errorhandler-bypass
assertions.description: Tests verify that ErrorHandler is NOT called for httpResource errors but IS called for component errors

assertions.name: onpush-and-signals
assertions.description: Components use OnPush and signal-based state
